findings.source_quote: When you meet a doctor, you tend to judge them based on their “bedside manner.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the literal "sengekant-manner" with a natural Bokmål expression such as "legens væremåte" or "måten legen opptrer på" (or the idiomatic "lege‑pasient‑møtet / lege‑pasientforholdet" if desired) to improve idiomatic clarity while preserving meaning.
findings.translation_quote: Når du møter en lege, har du en tendens til å dømme dem basert på deres “sengekant-manner”.

findings.source_quote: There are 36 trillion cells in the human body, and normally, they all work together perfectly; the problem is figuring out what to do when they don’t.
findings.suggested_fix: Although the numeric value is correctly converted to Norwegian scale, the term used "36 billioner" is correct for English "36 trillion" (10^12) but might confuse some readers. Consider adding a short clarifier (e.g., "36 billioner (36 trillioner i amerikansk engelskskala)") only if the publisher prefers absolute disambiguation. No mandatory change required.
findings.translation_quote: Det finnes 36 billioner celler i menneskekroppen, og normalt samarbeider de alle perfekt; problemet er å finne ut hva man skal gjøre når de ikke gjør det.
